title: Preserve inherited owner collision families consistently in campaign batches
body:
Campaign source validator inconsistently rejects unchanged duplicate families when both members are selected

The native campaign owner operator treats an existing identity/name family differently depending on whether one or two members appear in the same accepted batch. At current `campaign_owner_apply.py` SHA256 `4fb9bf0339d4621e56ee4278ae1b68eeadd371d6a7991a4c99ec7ee832670dca`, `_validate_records` explicitly permits an inherited key shared with an unselected owner, but its selected-only `new_identifiers/new_terms` check rejects the same unchanged family as “Final proposed owners collide.”

Exact counterexample: W02's current `Nh42ni_So42.yaml` candidate `ccf6bac1dd242b5b7370d2f75cf6fc21b2ccc975f4ed9c25ed3dbc927ca9e142` and `Nh42ni_So42_X_6_H2o.yaml` candidate `7ad2a20ca7bdef1b87c2e372de8a3f754c0f281e69b8632c85bda7ef96ddf8a2` each retain CHEBI:86149, their same paths, MAPPED statuses and authentic history prefixes. Each passes the original native validator alone; both together fail. No new owner, duplicate member or identity is proposed by these bounded alias/provenance edits. The native duplicate baseline explicitly retains this two-member `HYDRATE_FAMILY_UNREVIEWED`; #1050's form/CAS decision remains open and must not be resolved by the infrastructure fix.

Fix the consistency boundary by comparing exact before/after collision membership across the complete catalogue. Permit only inherited same-path/same-key pairs; continue refusing genuinely new pairs, create/promotion collisions, constant-size replacements, changed keys, preferred-name collisions, and tombstone revival. Preserve the separate duplicate-baseline gate and every original native provenance, schema, history, preimage, complete-inventory and publication guard. Do not split the batch to bypass the check or choose an identifier winner.

Read-only evidence: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/native-owner-boundary-design-v1/original-native-probe-results.json`; the original complete-boundary input SHA256 is `ebc7be2afbf6db639a4047a3ab4793a872bc0c3bc657139ff7b084c78b58c48d`. No fix or maintained application has been made. A distinct independent assessment and final regression review are required before implementation/application.

Distinct independent W08 technical and skeptical reviewers reproduced both original single-owner passes and the joint refusal in both orders (W08-NATIVE-BOUNDARY-001). Their exact findings snapshot SHA256 is `dd40f468b21ee641a30a87d5e20bbad78907632a9b08bf4a3b2c7b7b042b549d`. Add an explicit tombstone-revival negative: independent isolated record-stage probes currently accept REJECTED-to-MAPPED mutations; this is not a claimed full prepare/application bypass. Do not inaccurately describe that negative as an existing refusal. The implementation must establish it while retaining all complete-plan safety checks.

Live deduplication read all-state campaign titles and current #1174/#1197 bodies/comments; their membership, prospective-chain and publication scopes do not cover this selection-dependent collision inconsistency. The current scientific #1050 hold remains open.
